message.entry: The script must be a .m file, not "{0}".
The log view needs a uifigure, uipanel, uitab or uigridlayout of a uifigure, not a {0} (a figure made by figure() is not supported).
"{0}" is used by HistoryGUILDA to run the code and cannot be a variable of its workspace.
The workspace has no variable "{0}". Variables: {1}.
